CustomField.description: Stamped by Quote_Stamp_Order_Form_Fields on every save: true when any line is in the Subs - Legal Monitor product family. Drives the Order Form's conditional sections (Legal Monitor terms sentence + Schedule 1 terms) instead of the General Subscription Terms link.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically when the quote carries a Legal Monitor software line. The Order Form then references the Legal Monitor Terms and Conditions (printed as Schedule 1) instead of the General Subscription Terms.
CustomField.label: Order Form: Legal Monitor deal
